Record Class DashboardController.ChartJson

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.controller.DashboardController.ChartJson
Record Components:
selectedYear - the year shown as the current line
previousYear - the year before selectedYear
highestYear - the all-time highest year, or null
hasPreviousYear - whether a previous-year line is drawn
isPreviousYearHighest - whether the previous year is also the highest year
years - every year with data plus the current calendar year, newest first
series - the lines to draw, in order current, previous, highest
stats - the all-time statistics for the selected year
Enclosing class:
DashboardController
public static record DashboardController.ChartJson(int selectedYear, int previousYear, Integer highestYear, boolean hasPreviousYear, boolean isPreviousYearHighest, List<Integer> years, List<DashboardController.ChartSeries> series, DashboardController.AllTimeStatsJson stats) extends Record
The chart payload: series, year metadata and the all-time stats for the selected year.
